:::{#def-matrix-row}
#### Row of a matrix

The $i$th **row** of an $m \times n$ [matrix](#def-matrix) $\matr{A}$
is the $1 \times n$ row vector of the entries in row $i$:

$$
\matr{A}_{i,:} = \begin{bmatrix} a_{i1} & a_{i2} & \cdots & a_{in} \end{bmatrix}.
$$

Stacking the $m$ rows gives back the matrix,
so $\matr{A}$ is a column of row vectors:

$$
\matr{A} =
\begin{bmatrix}
\matr{A}_{1,:} \\
\vdots \\
\matr{A}_{m,:}
\end{bmatrix}.
$$

:::
